title: Collaboration, Review, Adaptation & Publication Workflow
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic collaboration, review, adaptation and publication-workflow preparation over MAS-01..19 while preserving canonical owner/resource/publication authority and keeping review, adaptation and publication proposals distinct from actual canonical publication or mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent deterministic Adventure collaboration/review/adaptation/publication workflow structures without treating collaboration proposals, review approvals, adaptation proposals or publication plans as proof that canonical publication or owner mutation occurred.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically prepare collaboration, review, adaptation and publication-workflow structures over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/resource/publication authority and never treating prepared review, approval, adaptation or publication workflow artifacts as proof that canonical publication or mutation occurred.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue on 2026-09-16 governed-started MAS-20; implementation authority is limited to work/mas-20-collaboration-review-adaptation-publication-workflow.
MAS-01 through MAS-19 remain completed foundations and must not be reopened silently.

Prepared collaboration/review/adaptation/publication workflow structures remain proposal/projection semantics and must not publish content, apply approvals/adaptations, mutate canonical owner/resource/publication state or claim those operations occurred.
Collaboration/review/adaptation/publication owner seams must be resolved from existing live application contracts during targeted dependency loading rather than invented.
Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition occurs in MAS-20.
MAS-21 retains Golden Adventure Capability & Playability Proof scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-21+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: Resolve only collaboration/review/adaptation/publication owner seams needed by MAS-20, establish causal RED on the named application branch, then implement minimum deterministic non-mutating workflow preparation behavior.
